'''Geesa shark''' was a [[Shark/Legends|shark]] species that became endangered. During the conflict with the [[Eternal Empire]], a high-ranking [[Gender/Legends|female]] official on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] wanted a breeding pair of the endangered Geesa sharks for her personal acquarium. She hired individuals who facilitated the acquisition discreetly.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Something Fishy}}</ref>
